---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest a capability or change to the public tool/manifest surface
title: ''
labels: enhancement
---

**Use case**
What are you trying to do? What problem does today's surface not solve?

**Proposed shape**
What would the new/changed tool, parameter, or manifest field look like? Tool name, parameter names, return shape if relevant.

**Alternatives considered**
Other approaches you've thought about, and why they don't fit.

**Notes**
Anything else — examples from other MCP servers, links to related discussions, etc.

> Per [CONTRIBUTING.md](../../CONTRIBUTING.md): this is a personal tool. Feature requests without patches will be politely declined. PRs implementing your proposal are welcome and read carefully.
